author: Norah Hale
text: Mike (the driver) did an excellent job pumping our septic system. He was professional, efficient, and very knowledgeable, taking the time to explain the process and provide helpful maintenance tips. Highly recommend this company!

author: Matthew Jefferson
text: Very professional and timely. I have called and they have come out on short notice to pump out my tank. We have used R and M for many years and would highly recommend to anyone needing their services! Mike thank you for taking care of our system!

author: CHRIS SMITH
text:
Very professional quick and clean service. Used Mike for 2 tank pumps now. Always goes over my system with me and tips on maintenance for longer life.
Will use again.

author: John Xiong
text:
From the phone call to completion of the septic pump, work and communication was all done professionally and respectfully. Mike is a very knowledgeable gentleman and presents himself very well. He takes great pride in his work and business as a whole and one can see that throughout his communication. Mike took the time to share his knowledge and answered questions, he too asked questions to better understand his customers and that was greatly appreciated!
I am glad my neighbor referred Mike’s business.
I highly recommend Mike! R&M Septic!

Thank you and I hope you enjoyed the eggrolls!

author: Niki Powers
text: We had great customer service with them! Kathy was so kind on the phone, helping to educate us and get us scheduled. Mike was very knowledgeable and helped to educate us on our septic system when he was out. They have a great competitive price and It was a pleasure to work with them!!
